chapter: Armstrong, Big Sid and Joe Glaser
title: Louis wrecks his Plymouth and the tea he smoked
summary: Louis, high on tea, ran into a bus and planned to give the wrecked car to his sister; Bigard says Crouch got him brick marijuana from Mexico, and Cozy Cole nearly crushed Louis's head after a racial insult in Europe.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: He had a little Plymouth -- and in those days he used to stay high off of tea, you know -- and he's taking it somewhere and he's driving and he's so busy talking he ran right into a big old bus, him and his Plymouth. Luckily, nobody got hurt. I said, "Now, look what you did." He said, "Oh, Pops, I'll send that to" -- he had a sister down in New Orleans -- he said, "I'll just fix it up and send it down and give it to her as a present." So I said, "Oh, Lord." And he -- didn't do nothing to him at all.

And the way he used to like Crouch so much because Crouch used to go to Mexico and get this tea for him, you know. But they called it a brick, compressed all together, and you paid 500 and $600 for that, and Crouch would get it for him. And that's what he -- anybody that smoked tea was great with him, you know.

So -- That's right, he and Trummy got along good. Cozy got along good until -- Cozy, he cussed Cozy out in Europe and he made Cozy so mad. That's the only time I ever seen Cozy get angry, and Cozy had him by the head and was going to crush him, and he says, "I still say you're a black nigger. You think you're big. You think you know it all. You think you're --
